headlines.text: Looking back to 2020, when AEW welcomed Cash Wheeler for the first time, appearing on Dynamite, rated 7.21 ? a good, competitive contest. FTR's in-ring debut for AEW, riding out to the ring in a pickup truck just as they had in WWE ? a statement of intent, with wrestling legends Arn Anderson, Jake Roberts, and Tully Blanchard all watching closely from the stands.

Turning the clock back to 2022: Will Ospreay announced their arrival in style, headlining their very first AEW appearance, appearing on Rampage, rated 7.76 ? a good, competitive contest. Fletcher arrived off the back of his Aussie Open run with Mark Davis, walking into AEW under the United Empire banner that would shape years of his career to come.

Looking back to 2020, when Cody vs. Marq Quen fought tooth and nail for the AEW TNT Title, appearing on Dynamite, rated 6.88. Marq Quen was challenging for gold for the very first time. A hard-fought battle for the gold.

secondaries.text: That Friday in 2022, Eddie Kingston vs. Jake Hager crossed paths for the first time ever, getting things started right out of the gate on Rampage, rated 6.41.
On this day in 2020, it marked the first-ever meeting between Sammy Guevara and Colt Cabana on Dynamite, rated 5.39.
Back on this day in 2020, it marked the first-ever meeting between Best Friends & Cassidy and Proud-N-Powerful & Hager on Dynamite, rated 5.36.
